hotels.vendor_name: Aulūs Lindos Rhodes, by Domes Resorts
hotels.title: Family-Friendly Rhodes Oceanfront Escape with Onsite Dining, Spa & Kids' Club
hotels.description: Sitting along the sun-drenched coast of Rhodes, close to the whitewashed lanes of Lindos village, Aulūs Lindos Rhodes by Domes is a dreamy all-inclusive resort built with families in mind. Spacious suites and private-pool retreats open onto sunlit terraces, with the warm light and relaxed pace of the Greek islands setting the tone from arrival. Dining is entirely taken care of across four restaurants - spanning Mediterranean comfort, Italian flair and Greek family recipes - along with a 24/7 buffet, food-fest evenings, grab-and-go beach bites and premium drinks at two bars throughout the day. KiEPOS Kids Club keeps younger guests happily occupied, while Soma Spa offers ELEMIS and Codage Paris treatments for parents looking to unwind.

hotels.vendor_name: Caesars Gardens Hotel & Spa - Adults Only- Rhodes, Greece
hotels.title: Boutique Greek Island Adults-Only Retreat with Outdoor Pool & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Seamlessly blending into Rhodes' natural landscape, this intimate, adults-only hotel is where Greek Island sophistication meets rustic charm. The crown jewel is the Magnolia Spa, featuring outdoor treatment pavillions amid ancient olive trees, while Tárate Restaurant serves traditional Greek cuisine using herbs and vegetables from the hotel's garden. Beyond the hotel's tranquil grounds, guests can explore Rhodes' immense southeastern coastline, with pristine beaches and hidden coves dotting the shoreline. Adventure seekers can discover ancient ruins perched dramatically on clifftops, while the nearby village of Lindos captivates with its maze of whitewashed alleyways, traditional tavernas and local craft boutiques.

hotels.title: Idyllic Greek Island Private Beach Retreat with 12 Restaurants & Bars & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: This beachfront Mediterranean treasure ticks all the boxes for a dreamy Greek island escape, offering everything along the unspoiled Gennadi Beach. Claim a spot along the beachfront or enjoy lazing poolside on an overwater sunbed, cocktail in hand. Taste your way through the resort’s eight restaurants and four bars, offering everything from buffet indulgence at Filoxenia Main Restaurant to fine dining Greek degustation at Eδesma. Take some time to relax at Kozeen Spas, treating yourself to a healing massage, hydrotherapy jacuzzi session or tailored facial treatment. Get your heart pumping with a game of tennis or beach volleyball (complimentary during daylight hours), unwind with yoga or water aerobics or hire a mountain bike to explore nearby cliffs and trails (additional charges apply).

hotels.title: Greece Rhodes Adults-Only Beachfront Escape with Seven Restaurants, Two Bars & Wellness Spa
hotels.description: Set on Rhodes' south-east coast, this polished resort overlooks Vlycha Bay and the Aegean Sea. Whitewashed rooms and suites feature private pools, while Aegeo Spa offers hammam rituals, sauna and an indoor pool with jacuzzi. Dine across internationally-inspired restaurants, from Takara Asian to Agistri Greek Fish, with rotating menus of traditional recipes, before heading into Lindos for tavernas and the Acropolis after dusk. Famed for iridescent waters, pebble shores and awe-inspiring ruins, there's no shortage of ways to spend your days. Easily accessible trails lead to the Paralia Vilcha coastline for bathing in the glittering sea, while ancient ruins and natural hot springs are a short drive away. Medieval Rhodes Town, Pefkos and boat trips to nearby coves are also within easy reach.
